messages:
maya: FYI: canary fleet (model-x50) shows a 4x 99p latency spike after the prefill heuristic bump. Started ~11:24 PDT.

ravi: Can you paste traces? Is this a KV cache miss storm or kernel fallback?

maya: Quick perf dump:
```
perf_summary:
  p50: 40ms
  p95: 90ms
  p99: 420ms  <-- spike
events:
  - continuous-batcher: prefill_window increased to 16 -> more handoffs
  - kernel: switched to small-batch kernels when batch_size < 4
kv_cache:
  hit_rate: 0.78 -> 0.62 during spike
```

jonah: kv hit drop + handoffs smell like prefix cache invalidations. Any recent cache GC?

maya: We did a KV GC tweak two deploys ago, but that was for dedicated infra. This is on canary/hosted. Also saw microbursts of tiny batches (many batch_size=1).

perf-bot: ALERT: 99p latency > 300ms for 5m on canary/model-x50. Throughput -12%.

priya: @maya can you share a flamegraph or trace link?

maya: Link: https://perf.redwood/internal/canary/x50/171800 (perf UX link)

maya: Uploading short trace snippet: 
```
[11:24:10] batcher: handoff prefill->live, batch_size=1, kernel=small
[11:24:11] runtime: kernel_fallback_count=7
[11:24:11] kv: lookup_ms=9.2 (typ 0.8)
[11:24:11] kernel: small_batch_exec_ms=120
```

katie: If batches fall to size=1 we lose kernel vectorization -> big 99p jump. Did the heuristic increase token_budget_target?

maya: Yes — token_budget_target increased from 256 -> 512 for mid-sized streaming requests to boost throughput. Side effect: more prefill handoffs when clients stream small token bursts.

ravi: Can we reproduce locally by replaying requests with different token pacing to force handoffs and KV misses?

maya: Running a canary replay now with old token_budget_target. Will post results in ~20m.

maya: Replay results: p99 back to ~110ms after rolling token_budget_target back. Throughput stayed ~same. Strongly indicates prefill->live handoff timing + temporary KV priming failure = root cause.

jonah: Proposal: 1) add a min_batch_size threshold before switching kernels 2) hold prefill handoff until KV primed (or until KV hit_rate crosses a short window) 3) tune token_budget_target for streaming clients.

priya: :thumbsup: Also add console metrics for handoff_rate and kernel_fallback_rate so we can alert earlier.

perf-bot: TICKET CREATED: PERF-3212 — handoff-kv-interaction-sla-blip. Owner: maya. Priority: P2.

maya: I'll push a small canary with min_batch_size=2 and token_budget_target=320, schedule in ~2h and report back.
